evals.name: full-build-telemedicine
evals.prompt: My SLR title is 'Telemedicine adoption among elderly patients in rural areas: a systematic review'. Give me the search strings for Scopus, Web of Science and Google Scholar. Last 5 years only.
evals.expected_output: Concept table summary, Scopus + WoS + two Scholar strings, next-step guidance, no claim the strings were tested.
assertions: Scopus string starts with TITLE-ABS-KEY( and ends with PUBYEAR > 2021 AND PUBYEAR < 2027
Web of Science string starts with TS=( and ends with PY=(2022-2026)
Every concept in the Scopus and WoS strings is wrapped in its own brackets joined by AND
Both Google Scholar strings are 256 characters or fewer and contain no * ? or $
Quoted multi-word phrases that can be plural carry a truncated last word (e.g. "telehealth service*") or the plural is written out, so Web of Science does not miss them
The reply does not claim the strings were run or tested, and asks the user to send back hit counts

evals.name: repair-pasted-string
evals.prompt: this scopus search gives me an error and then 0 results when i fix the brackets, can you fix it? TITLE-ABS-KEY((“social media” OR facebook OR instagram) AND (adolescen* or teen*) AND (“body image” OR behavio?r)) AND PUBYEAR > 2020
evals.expected_output: Diagnoses curly quotes, lower-case or, behavio?r missing American spelling, and gives a corrected string.
assertions: The corrected string uses only straight double quotes
The corrected string writes OR in capitals everywhere
The reply names curly quotes as a cause
The corrected string has balanced brackets and balanced quotes

evals.name: word-file-local-language
evals.prompt: Please make me a Word file with the search strategy table for my review 'E-commerce adoption among small businesses in Indonesia'. I also want an Indonesian-language string. Save the docx in your outputs folder.
evals.expected_output: A valid .docx with concept table and search-result table including an Indonesian-language Scholar row.
assertions: A .docx file exists in the outputs folder and opens as a valid zip
The docx contains a Google Scholar row labelled for Indonesian, not Malay
The Indonesian string is not joined to the English strings with AND
The reply gives the strings in the chat as well as the file
